clips.title: The story
paras: In Westfall, Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure sends you inland after a clue found by the shore. The trail leads east from the coast toward a barrel near ruined stonework.
Captain Sanders sends you inland after the first cipher is solved. The clue points away from the shore and up the rocky bluffs, toward Westfall's main roads.
An old chimney among roadside ruins marks the next stop. A discarded barrel nearby hides another message, and the ruined farmstead gives Sanders a landmark for the trail.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The clue to the treasure reads: Good work, matey! Now ye need to head due east. East up the bluffs, east to the road. Look for the ol' chimney ruins near the side of the road. There you'll find an old barrel with your next clue.
